gstack.milestone_pin: eval-first floor + on-demand content loading (v1.46), /spec intent→spec 5-phase (v1.47), shared redaction engine (v1.53), carved skills skeleton+sections/ (v1.56/1.57), event-sourced DECISION/VERDICT layer (v1.57.5 decisions.jsonl + decisions.active.json; v1.57.7 mandatory unresolved-decisions verdict line that blocks the approval gate; gstack-review-log machine verdict), gen-skill-docs writes into project .claude/gstack-rendered/ (v1.57.9 — gstack-owned enclave in OUR namespace), codex_reviews default-on (v1.61 — changelog-summarized, gate recalibration on local probe), host-anchored plan signals (v1.62 — UNVERIFIED watch item). Memory Ingest (v1.26) and gstack-brain→gstack-artifacts rename (v1.27) are BELOW the floor — legacy gstack-brain* dual-value bridges sunset in v3.6.0. NOTE: gstack ships NO .claude-plugin/plugin.json — detect by skill dirs, never a manifest. GitHub Releases page is EMPTY — drift channel is raw VERSION/CHANGELOG fetch only.

_bridge_doc: Paths probe gstack's CURRENT (post-v1.27) surface only. The gstack-brain* legacy dual-value paths were dropped once min_supported (1.46) rose above the v1.27 rename floor (legacy_sunset FIRED). Consumers glob; absence is graceful degrade. A future gstack rename re-introduces dual-value bridges TEMPORARILY, then sunsets them on the same rule.

bridges._enclave_note: gstack v1.57.9 gen-skill-docs writes rendered skill docs into the project's .claude/gstack-rendered/ — a gstack-OWNED enclave inside our namespace. We never write/flag it: gitignored (harness-init), excluded from entropy-sweep scans and doc-drift-check.
bridges.confusion_metrics: .claude/metrics/confusion.jsonl [RESERVED/INACTIVE — no producer observed; upstream Confusion Protocol status probed at contract check; hard-delete at next quarterly check if probe confirms sunset]

composition._command_binding_note: Slash-command names below are gstack's CURRENT surface; gstack ships ~daily and renames commands (e.g. /ux-audit → /design-review at the v1.x line). These are capability bindings, not pins: gstack-sync --contract-check reconciles them against gstack's authoritative llms.txt when present. Treat a missing command as graceful-degrade, never a hard failure.
composition.intent_to_spec: gstack:/spec (v1.47; vague intent → executable spec in 5 phases, codex quality gate. UPSTREAM of harness /spec-to-task — which does spec → layer-aware exec-plan JSON. Clean handoff, not duplication.)
composition.redaction_engine: gstack:shared redaction engine (v1.53; strips secrets/PII LEAVING to public sinks. Complementary to — NOT overlapping — our safety-check/bash-safety-check hooks, which block secrets ENTERING source at edit-time. Two directions, both kept.)
composition.isolated_repro: gstack:/investigate + /qa (own bug reproduction in isolation; we delegate, never duplicate)
composition.memory_ingest: gstack:bin/gstack-memory-ingest (gstack-internal; we never invoke or write)
composition.decision_layer: gstack:decisions.jsonl + decisions.active.json + gstack-review-log (v1.57.5+; READ-ONLY advisory context for /verify + /harness-review reconciliation. We surface gstack's verdict alongside ours; on AGREE we pass through, on DIVERGE we halt NEEDS_HUMAN:judgment-slop. We NEVER compute an aggregate, rewrite our decision from gstack, or write gstack paths — SIGNAL-not-ARTIFACT bright line.)

policies.gstack_verdict_reconciliation: read-only-advisory: /verify probes gstack decision/verdict layer as report CONTEXT (never folded into verify-latest.json); /harness-review reads gstack-review-log + decisions.active.json, surfaces both verdicts, and on divergence emits NEEDS_HUMAN:judgment-slop. Agree ⇒ pass through. Our signal stays the accountable arbiter; gstack findings are advisory. Absence ⇒ graceful degrade (our signal stands alone).
policies.gbrain_detection: CLI/MCP first ('command -v gbrain' then 'gbrain doctor'), then ~/.gstack-artifacts-worktree/, then project-local. The brain-remote (~/.gstack-brain-remote.txt) and artifacts-remote (~/.gstack-artifacts-remote.txt) are TWO DISTINCT remotes, NOT a rename — never assume artifacts-only implies gbrain absence.
policies._legacy_sunset_note: gstack-brain* legacy paths were DROPPED in v3.6.0 (2026-06-06) once min_supported rose to 1.46 > the v1.27 rename floor — executing the plugin's own rule legacy-sunset instead of globbing two paths forever (unbounded entropy, against our own anti-entropy mission). graceful_degradation still protects any genuine pre-v1.27 caller (absence = no-op). A future gstack rename re-introduces dual-value bridges TEMPORARILY, then sunsets on the same rule.
capability_oracle: raw-fetch VERSION+CHANGELOG from GitHub (network, LAST — quarterly check must not acquire a hard network dependency; Releases page is empty, VERSION/CHANGELOG is the only drift channel)
policies.ship_gate_status: ASSERTED — our-side convention (docs/SIGNALS.md pre-ship check); no evidence gstack reads our signals. gstack-sync --contract-check probes and reports VERIFIED | ASSERTED; a grep miss is never 'gstack ignores signals'.
policies.workflows_policy: anti-bloat rule single-workflow: workflows <=1, read-only (Explore agents), audit-only, RETURNS a decision signal (accountable invoker persists it — never a relay write); never advances a delivery phase, mutates source, commits, opens a PR, or calls a gstack lifecycle skill. ONE shipped (v3.7.0): .claude/workflows/harness-audit.js — A/B spike cleared the evidence gate (3x recall vs sequential, zero overlap; ~17% false positives filtered by adversarial verify).
